senses.gloss: m. (denom. of סוּלְיָיס) a shoe consisting of a mere sole.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 103b:5">Yeb. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>פרט לסנדל המ׳ וכ׳</he> to exclude the sandal which consists merely of a sole and has no heel; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 938">Yalk. Deut. 938</cite> <he>מסוליי׳</he>, <he>מוסליי׳</he>; <cite ref="Kiddushin 14a">Kidd. 14ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>פרט למסולים</he> (Ar. <he>לסוּלְיָיס</he>).
